domain: Finance / Tax SaaS for CA Firms

theme_strategy.description: An authoritative, high-density, trust-inspiring dashboard tailored for 50-year-old CA partners in India. Rejects startup-fluff (no purple gradients, no emojis). Relies on Swiss-style structural alignment, crisp typography optimized for tabular data, and highly intentional use of color for alerts (Missed TDS, ITC mismatches).

typography.instructions: Always use 'tabular-nums' class for any financial figures or dates to ensure vertical alignment in tables. Indian number system formatting (e.g. ₹ 1,50,00,000) is mandatory.

layout_spacing.topbar: h-16 bg-white border-b border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-between px-6 flex-shrink-0

surface_styles.card: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-lg shadow-sm p-6
surface_styles.card_danger: bg-white border border-red-200 rounded-lg shadow-sm p-6 border-t-4 border-t-red-600
surface_styles.card_success: bg-white border border-green-200 rounded-lg shadow-sm p-6 border-t-4 border-t-green-600

buttons.primary: bg-[#0B2B5B] text-white hover:bg-[#082046] px-4 py-2 rounded-md text-sm font-medium transition-colors shadow-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-slate-700 border border-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-50 px-4 py-2 rounded-md text-sm font-medium transition-colors
buttons.danger: bg-red-600 text-white hover:bg-red-700 px-4 py-2 rounded-md text-sm font-medium transition-colors

tables.header: bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-200 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider py-3 px-4 text-left
tables.cell_numeric: py-3 px-4 text-sm text-slate-900 font-mono text-right tabular-nums
tables.rules: Highly dense tables. Right-align all numeric values. Add zebra striping if rows exceed 15.

badges.safe: inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-medium bg-green-100 text-green-800
badges.risk: inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-medium bg-red-100 text-red-800
badges.pending: inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-medium bg-amber-100 text-amber-800
badges.neutral: inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-medium bg-slate-100 text-slate-800

icons.style: Use 18px-20px icons, stroke-width 2, color matched to text hierarchy. No emojis under any circumstance.

executive_dashboard.layout: 4-col KPI strip at top. 12-col grid below: 8-col for Compliance Timeline/Missed Alerts, 4-col for Risk Summary pie/bar charts.
key_elements: ITC at Risk Hero Card (emphasize the ₹ amount in Red)
Client Health Overview (Safe vs At Risk counts)

clients_list.layout: Full page table view with robust filters.
key_elements: Data table with inline status badges

documents_upload.layout: Split view: 4-col drag-drop zone, 8-col processing queue list.
key_elements: Dashed border dropzone with muted icon
Processing list with OCR status pills (Processing, Success, Failed)

gst_reconciliation.layout: Top controls (Period, Vendor filter). Summary cards. Dense Mismatch Table.

tds_alerts.layout: Hero Warning card on top left. Detailed vendor tracking table below.
key_elements: Total Penalty Estimate Hero (Red background accent)

ca_partner_avatar.description: Professional avatar for the topbar user profile

instructions_to_main_agent: INSTALLATION: Add '@fontsource/cabinet-grotesk' and '@fontsource/ibm-plex-sans'. Configure them in tailwind.config.js.
HTML STRUCTURE: Only use standard HTML/Tailwind for layouts. Use shadcn/ui ONLY for interactive logic (Dialogs, Selects, Calendars).
TESTING: Every interactive element MUST have a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='upload-invoice-btn').
DATA FORMATTING: You must implement an Indian currency formatter `new Intl.NumberFormat('en-IN', { style: 'currency', currency: 'INR' })`. Do not use default US formatting.
DENSITY: Keep padding in tables and lists tight (py-2 px-3 or py-3 px-4). Do not introduce unnecessary white space inside data grids.
COLORS: Do not use purple or teal. Stick to the provided palette: Deep Navy, Slate, Red (danger), Green (success).
CHARTING: If using Recharts, explicitly use the colors defined in the 'colors.brand' and 'colors.semantic' blocks.
